text: Fii wata Annabiijo on (yo Alla juulu e makko O hisina mo) yollitu faade e ko fennuɓe ɓen hawjirta kon lepte ɗen, Alla Daalani mo: "Ko Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- woni Surroowo bakkatuuji jeyaaɓe Makko tuubu6 ɓe ɓen, ko O Jom Yurmeende, nden yaajannde kala huunde, no jeyaa e Yurmeende Makko nden wonnde Kanko O nennanay yedduɓe ɓen bela-jo'o kamɓe ɓe tuubay ɓe ruttoto e Makko, sinndo Kanko O toowii, O leptayno ɓee ɗuuriiɓe O yaccinanayno ɓe lepte ɗen ka ngurdan aduna, kono Kanko ko O Munñiiɗo Yurmiteeɗo, O nennane ɓe lepte ɗen fii yo ɓe tuubu, ko woni, no woodani ɓe nokkuure e jamaanu happaaɗi ɗiɗi ɓe yoɓoyte e mayre keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun e ɗuuragol maɓɓe ngol si tawii ɓe tuubaali, ɓe heɓataa gaanin mayre fattorde nde ɓe fattoo e mun.
